item.title: Marcus Aurelius Meditations by Prof. Michael Sugrue
item.description:
A very engaging and thought provoking lecture on Stoicism and about Marcus Aurelius by Prof. Michael Sugrue (Ph.D., Princeton University).
You can watch it on YouTube, where it is freely available. Here is video link.

These are my notes on his lecture. It’s not exactly same to lecture but have most of the essence of his lecture.

Marcus Aurelius’ Meditations: The Stoic Ideal

Stoicism is a noble philosophy, an excellent philosophy for silver men—for those spirited men in the Republic who are going to be our Guardians. It’s an excellent philosophy for military men. It’s an excellent philosophy for people that are going to be practical politicians, if they intend to be virtuous, if they intend to pursue the public good.
